context:
Goal: none of your feedback is lost.
Problem (rule): PR #1008 adds docs/plans/owner-feedback-audit.md, a table of F1 to F252 with each item's state on Nov 2 (172 landed, 40 in flight, 7 filed not started). A plan is a working file, deleted when its work ships, and this snapshot has aged.
Based on (read): #1008's body; its branch merges clean.
Departs from: main has no audit file — a dated snapshot lands, or none.

options.gain: The verbatim owner words and their homes are kept in git.
options.label: Merge it as a dated record
options.lose: A five-day-old status table that no check keeps true.

options.gain: The rows that still need work get real homes; no stale table.
options.label: Close it; a lane first files the 7 'filed not started' and 6 'unknown' rows as steps (recommended)
options.lose: The full table lives only in the closed PR.

reply: You picked b: a lane files the audit's 7 'filed not started' and 6 'unknown' rows as steps, then closes #1008. Sent to the coordinator at 12:38 CST; home: step pr-backlog-clear. Closed.
short: Idle PR #1008: the Nov 2 owner-feedback audit
title: Idle PR #1008 (the Nov 2 audit of your 252 feedback items): merge it as a record, or close it?
why: It has sat as a draft since Nov 2. Its counts were true on Nov 2 and are now five days old.
